description: This PHP source file defines an 'Issue' class for interacting with a Redmine issue tracker via the ActiveResource pattern. It includes configuration for connecting to a Redmine server and demonstrates usage of the 'Issue' class to find and dump issues, with commented-out code for updating and deleting issues.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: A class representing an issue resource in Redmine, extending ActiveResource for RESTful interactions.

methods.description: Constructor inheriting from ActiveResource, setting up resource-specific configurations.
